[[Image:eql20-logo.png|right|EQL20 Logo]] == Introduction == * '''Website:''' http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql20/ * '''Gametype:''' [[4on4]] Team Deathmatch * '''Number of teams:''' 15 * '''Structure:''' Divisions, 1 * '''Number of playoff teams:''' Top 4 for Playoffs A, Top 5-8 for Playoffs B, Top 9-15 for Playoffs C. * '''Admins:''' [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Hooraytio]], [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[Zalon]] * '''Clients allowed:''' ** Open source clients (with source code publicly availible on Internet) that have equivalent checks/restrictions of ezQuake's: *** Ruleset smackdown *** Client has to answer to f_modified and do the same checks and restrictions as ezQuake's f_modified *** Movement script prevention *** Client has to answer f_version with proper information of client name/version/os * '''Map pool:''' [[DM2]], [[DM3]], [[E1M2]] * '''Maps to win:''' [[Best of three]] (Divisions), [[Best of five]] (Playoffs) * '''First game:''' [[2015]]-09-13 - [[Division Ninety Nine Blue]] vs [[Crazy 88]] * '''Last game:''' ??? == Results == === [http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql20/division/1 Group Stage] === [[Image:EQL20-group-standings.png|EQL20 Group Standings Screenshot]]
